evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Game-creation is present and complementary game lifecycle stories (delete, browse, transcripts) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invitation via URL has complementary join story (PP-029) so no creation/acceptance gap is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Round start and item management stories (add/edit/delete/select items) are present to support rounds.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Listing of items is supported and complemented by item add/edit/delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is supported alongside item creation and editing stories (PP-006, PP-007).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Item creation is present and complemented by edit and delete capabilities (PP-007, PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Edit is supported and the backlog includes creation (PP-006) and deletion (PP-008) for completeness.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete is accompanied by item creation and edit stories, so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Estimate display behaviors are covered by related stories for showing estimates both immediately and after all estimators have played.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting agreed estimates is supported and complemented by estimate display and entry stories.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: This behavior references showing estimates which is supported elsewhere (PP-009, PP-033); no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering agreed estimates is covered along with acceptance and display features; complementary flows exist.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported by item/history and round selection stories (prior-round navigation and transcripts).

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import and copy/paste story intake options are present, covering necessary creation/import capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Bulk story entry is present and complements manual add/edit/delete story management.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported and complemented by viewing and exporting transcripts and deleting games.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcripts can be viewed and exported (PP-018, PP-019) so no transcript-related capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export in multiple formats is supported and complemented by view and CSV export stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript viewing/export features; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion complements creation (PP-001) and browsing/exporting stories; both sides of lifecycle are present.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: Account creation has complementary login, change, and delete account stories (PP-022, PP-023, PP-024).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is supported and backed by account creation and password reminder stories (PP-021, PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is supported alongside creation and deletion; no complementary requirement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion complements creation and other account management stories present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a standalone UI/data presentation requirement and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password recovery is present and paired with account/email in account creation (PP-021).

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Card-set selection is a configuration feature and does not require additional missing capabilities in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation limits complement the invitation mechanism (PP-002) and joining flow (PP-029); no missing capability shown.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Join flow complements invitation by URL (PP-002); the creation/acceptance path is present.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the current item is supported by item creation and round selection stories; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Session item listing is supported by item add/edit/delete features; complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing who has estimated is supported by participant identity and joining stories; no missing complementary requirement is evident.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Synchronized reveal behavior is covered and complemented by per-estimator and round control stories.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Estimate-change mechanics are supported by draw completion and reveal stories; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Prior-estimate/history viewing is supported by transcript and prior-round navigation stories (PP-017, PP-039).

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Real-time attribution is supported by join/identity and estimate display stories; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Shared timer feature is self-contained and complemented by timer-reset behavior in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset behavior complements the shared timer and estimate-play flows; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Prior-round navigation and transcript/export stories provide the complementary storage and viewing capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a presentation requirement and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate-change rules are supported by draw completion and display stories; complementary flows exist.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: The backlog requires displaying a user thumbnail but contains no story to create/upload/assign a user's photo or avatar, indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards/compliance requirements are standalone non-functional requirements and do not expose missing complementary user-story capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/documentation requirement is self-contained; no missing complementary feature is evident.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance tasks are implementation-level developer stories and do not reveal missing complementary application features in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is a non-functional requirement and does not imply a missing complementary user-story capability.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement is non-functional; no complementary user-story capability is missing from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness is a quality requirement and does not expose a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a technical requirement and does not imply a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a presentation/UX concern and does not expose a missing complementary feature in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error-page UX is a standalone non-functional requirement; no complementary user-story is missing.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Privacy/anonymization requirement is present; although other stories show identifying information during live use, the backlog does not expose a missing complementary capability required to meet this privacy requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics requirement is standalone and implementable; the backlog does not expose a missing complementary capability preventing metrics collection/display.
